title: Approve or reject a TTO video linking request as a creator
content_data:
Use this endpoint to approve or reject a request for linking your public video to a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace campaign. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/creator/link/request/confirm/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok creators.
Use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-renew-or-revoke-a-creator-access-token/v1.3#item-link-Obtain%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) or [/tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-renew-or-revoke-a-creator-access-token/v1.3#item-link-Renew%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) endpoint to get or renew an access token.| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | |creator_id {Required}|string|Application specific unique ID of the TikTok account.

Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1768493902119937#item-link-Obtain%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) or [/tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1768493902119937#item-link-Renew%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) to this field.| | link_request_id {Required} | string | The ID of the linking request.

To obtain the ID, use [/tto/creator/link/request/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1837247726007298) and check the returned `link_request_id`. | | action {Required} | string | Action to be taken.

Enum values:
  • `APPROVE`: To approve the linking request.
  • `REJECT`: To reject the linking request.
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/creator/link/request/confirm/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "creator_id": "{{creator_id}}", "link_request_id": "{{link_request_id}}", "action": "APPROVE" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.

For a successful request, this field will be an empty object (`{}`).| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": {} } (/code) ```
